quantize_model_mxfp4: quantize a transformer model to MXFP4 with per-group 32 using QuantizationModifier and oneshot
load_causal_lm_model: load a causal language model and tokenizer from a Hugging Face model ID
generate_text_output: generate text from a quantized model using tokenizer input and model.generate
save_quantized_model: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk in compressed-tensors format
dispatch_model_offload: dispatch a quantized model for GPU offload inference with dispatch_model
